picks.editorial_note: An AI model designed a bacteriophage used in the first-ever treatment of a patient with an antibiotic-resistant infection — a striking real-world demonstration of generative AI directly producing a therapeutic agent, not just assisting discovery.
picks.title: This time, the virus is on the patient’s side. AI helped design it

picks.editorial_note: A $53 million ARPA-H award is a substantial federal bet on generative AI for drug/compound discovery, here applied to next-generation herbicides — notable both for the funding scale and the public-health angle of reducing chemical health risks.
picks.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers

picks.editorial_note: CSIRO's ML-based imaging technique independently confirmed the iconic Event Horizon Telescope black hole image in Nature, showing AI methods can validate and strengthen landmark physics results, not just generate new ones.
picks.title: New CSIRO technique confirms iconic black hole image

picks.editorial_note: WorldParticle's single model unifying simulation of wildly different physical phenomena (granular flow, protein folding) points toward general-purpose physics AI, a meaningful step beyond narrow, domain-specific simulators.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic partnership to transfer research into 'sovereign' industrial AI reflects the growing push by European institutions to build independent AI/robotics/cybersecurity capacity outside US and Chinese platforms.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics maker Unitree, building toward a joint lab, is a concrete academia-industry bet on embodied AI and robotics commercialization in a fast-moving competitive field.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: A $19 million state grant to build an AI-integrated computing cluster for semiconductor simulation underscores how regional governments are directly funding AI infrastructure tied to chip manufacturing competitiveness.
picks.title: Texas Tech Receives $19 Million Grant to Further Semiconductor Innovation | Texas Tech Now

picks.editorial_note: MIT and CMU's 'Workspace Models' give robots a cheaper way to recall relevant past observations, addressing a core bottleneck (memory cost) in deploying AI-driven robots for complex, long-horizon tasks.
picks.title: A new form of memory helps robots learn complex skills

picks.editorial_note: SMU's NIST-funded Digital Twin Technology Lab ties AI and HPC directly to semiconductor manufacturing workforce training, reflecting continued federal investment in AI-skilled manufacturing talent pipelines.
picks.title: SMU awarded $4.2 million to advance AI-driven manufacturing and workforce training

picks.editorial_note: Allegations tying Nvidia's CEO to a suspected Chinese espionage case raise real national-security questions for the company at the center of the global AI hardware supply chain, with potential policy and export-control ramifications.
picks.title: Nvidia CEO’s scandal raises questions about US national security
